title: Tower Fall Yellowstone Waterfall, 1950s B&W Snapshot, Wyoming
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot depicting Tower Fall in Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming. The image highlights the steep drop of Tower Creek as it plunges down the canyon framed by dramatic volcanic rock pinnacles and pine forest. The photo features classic scalloped/deckled edges typical of mid-20th-century amateur photofinishing.
